<thought>To meet the one‑step requirement, I will look for a simple ester exchange (transesterification) that converts a readily available ethyl ester into the desired methyl ester using methanol. Ethyl esters of many carboxylic acids are common commercial chemicals, and methanol is inexpensive. The retrosynthetic step is therefore:

Target methyl ester  
← (transesterification, template_id = 1010)  
Precursors: methanol (CO) and the corresponding ethyl ester  
SMILES of ethyl ester: CCOC(=O)[C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O

I will verify that both methanol and this ethyl ester are commercially available.</thought>
